However, the only matter listed in the registration is 'monitoring of matters related to AI/SI, telecommunications, spaceflight services and infrastructure', and the words Ukraine, Starshield and Department of Defense do not appear. Himes, who will become House Intelligence Committee chair in 2027-01, wrote to the CEO on 11/20 'It is difficult for me to continue supporting the authorization of funding' (CNN report, original text not public).
